stack: single static index.html, no build step, no backend

style.note: No GetLayers Style committed: the site keeps its own type (Unbounded, Manrope, Inter Tight, Inter, Noto Serif Display) and its neon red on dark. Every asset is tinted through CONFIG to the site's own tokens instead.

assets.made_with: getlayers_scene_lab, references only: ink-ticker (comic-ink look: flat colour, one heavy ink line, cream die-cut edge) and brewns (motion: beans drifting weightless behind the cup)
assets.placed: #top hero, div.foodstream first in <main> (z-index -1, behind every word); runs 26% past the hero's foot, then fades
assets.how: cartoon SVG stickers in images/stream (burger, double, fries, ring, soda, fry) as ; Web Animations on transform and opacity only, 48 keyframes along a Catmull-Rom river, plus a slow bob; seeded cast, so the same river on every load; all knobs in the food stream CONFIG
assets.replaces: the WebGL light stream (red lines), removed October 2026 because it lagged on phones

assets.placed: #ld overlay at the top of <body>; wordmark 'BUNS AND GUNS' (13 glyphs, last lands 2.28s)
assets.how: timings verbatim (1.2s glyph, 0.09s step, cubic-bezier(.05,.9,.1,1), 105% + 20px blur); gate on last glyph or 2.3s fallback, 0.3s exit, gone by 2.6s

assets.use: reference only, read with getlayers_source; nothing installed or copied
borrowed: hero reveal numbers (hero-copy.tsx): line clip 110% -> 0 at 90ms stagger, 900ms easeOutCubic; lede 650ms easeOutQuart at 260ms; CTA at 520ms; header drops 12px at 120ms
order receipt (order-receipt.tsx): paper slip, dotted gradient rules, torn-edge teeth, fed out in steps -> #ticket in the builder
header over surfaces (site-header.tsx, header-theme.ts): data-header-theme probe at the header's centre line; hides over the footer on phones

rules.aboveTheFold: no WebGL anywhere; the hero's moving layer is the food stream, run by the compositor
rules.reducedMotion: no loader; the food holds still where it lies; the ticker stands still
rules.phones: 18 smaller items instead of 28; the stream pauses when the hero is off screen or the tab is hidden; the page's frame loop sleeps when the page is still, so idle at the top there is no main-thread work at all

removed: hearth-008 (hero gradient) and clinker-008 (footer gradient): no longer on the page, only old comments mention them
WebGL hero light stream: replaced by food-stream
